title: RobotSession
description: A container grouping all events in one robot interaction session

robot_id.description: Identifier of the physical robot unit running this session

user_id.description: Identifier of the user interacting with the robot in this session

start_ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the session started

end_ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the session ended. Null if session is still active

duration_s.description: Total duration of the session in seconds. Computed when session ends

is_active.description: True if the session is currently ongoing, false once ended

end_reason.description: Why the session was closed. Null while session is still active

total_events.description: Running count of all events logged in this session. Incremented on every POST /api/events

event_type_counts.description: Breakdown of total_events by type. Updated live as events arrive.

voice_command.description: Number of voice_command events in this session

gesture.description: Number of gesture events in this session

wake_word.description: Number of wake_word events in this session

avg_confidence.description: Average confidence_score across all events in this session. Computed when session ends

success_rate.description: Proportion of successful events in this session (0–1). Computed when session ends

low_quality_event_count.description: Number of events in this session with confidence_score < 0.6. Computed when session ends

retry_count_total.description: Sum of retry_count across all events in this session

avg_processing_latency_ms.description: Average processing latency in ms across all events in this session. Computed when session ends

avg_response_latency_ms.description: Average response latency in ms across all events in this session. Computed when session ends
